After witnessing [[Clearlove]], his idol winning [[2015 Mid-Season Invitational]], he decided to become a pro. Noticed by [[PDD]], the boss of [[Young Miracles]], Tian received his first offer of joining [[Young Miracles]] as a young prospect. ===2017 Season=== in 2017, Tian joined [[Young Miracles]], known as the "West Point" of LPL, as the substitute of [[Ning]]. After Ning left the team for [[Invictus Gaming]], Tian eventually got his chance to play in the [[LDL]] games. That year, [[Young Miracles]] did not get promoted to [[LPL]]. ===2018 Season=== With the help of his boss, [[PDD]], Tian and his teammate, [[Knight (Zhuo Ding)]] were both introduced to [[Suning]]. Nonetheless, while Knight soon won himself a place in the team, Tian struggled to compete with the other jungler in [[Suning]], [[H4cker]]. In the end of the season, Tian left the team for [[FunPlus Phoenix]]. ===2019 Season=== Tian joined [[FunPlus Phoenix]] in 2019, a year that Tian finally grew and shined. Influenced and tutored by FPX's mid laner, [[Doinb]], Tian soon formed great chemistry with the team and won [[LPL 2019 Summer Playoffs]]. Then, [[FunPlus Phoenix]] participated in [[2019 World Championship]] as the first seed of [[LPL]]. Though struggled in group stage, Tian and his team dominated in the knockout stage, where they successfully defeated [[Fnatic]] and [[Invictus Gaming]]. In the final against [[G2 Esports]], [[FunPlus Phoenix]] crashed their component with 3:0, with Tian's stellar performance in jungling. Tian was later chosen as the MVP of the final. == Trivia == * Known for his {{ci|Qiyana}} and {{ci|Lee Sin}}. * His ID '''Tian''' is based on his given name (Tian-Liang). * Was the MVP of the [[2019 Season World Championship|Worlds 2019]] Finals. * Is a huge anime fan. * Featured in "Take Over" - Worlds 2020 promotional music video as a side character. * In early 2021, he had to take a break from the competitive scene due to overwhelming stress. * Is nicknamed tortoise with garlic (蒜头王八), which is also a nickname for the pokemon Bulbasaur. === Statistics === * Reached 1000 kills in the LPL on July 02, 2022. ** The 33rd player and 4th jungler (after [[Clearlove]], [[SofM]], and [[Karsa]]) to reach 1000 kills in the LPL. * Reached 1500 kills in the LPL on June 23, 2024. ** The 23rd player and 2nd jungler (after [[Kanavi]]) to reach 1500 kills in the LPL. * Reached 2000 kills in the LPL on August 27, 2025. ** The 18th player and 2nd jungler after Kanavi to reach 2000 kills in the LPL. * Reached 3000 assists in the LPL on February 28, 2023. ** Was the 19th player to reach 3000 assists in the LPL. * Reached 4000 assists in the LPL on April 20, 2024. ** The 14th player to reach 4000 assists in the LPL, after [[meiko]], [[Pyl (Chen Bo)|Pyl]], [[Ming (Shi Sen-Ming)|Ming]], [[xiaohu]], [[Rookie]], [[cold]], [[Doinb]], [[Crisp]], [[LvMao]], [[Missing]], [[Scout]], [[Flandre]], and [[Yagao]]. * Reached 5000 assists in the LPL on July 20, 2025. ** The 9th player to reach 5000 assists in the LPL after [[meiko]], [[Ming (Shi Sen-Ming)|Ming]], [[xiaohu]], [[Crisp]], [[Rookie]], [[Missing]], [[Scout]], and [[Doinb]]. * Reached 300 wins in the LPL on June 30, 2023. ** Was the 16th player to reach 300 wins in the LPL. * Reached 400 wins in the LPL on April 07, 2025. ** Was the 12th player to reach 400 wins in the LPL. * Reached 500 games in the LPL on February 26, 2024 ** The 22nd player to reach 500 games in the LPL. * Reached 600 games in the LPL on March 22, 2025 ** The 15th player to reach 600 games in the LPL. * Reached 700 games in the LPL on August 28, 2025 ** The 10th player to reach 700 games in the LPL after meiko, xiaohu, Rookie, Scout, Flandre, Crisp, JackeyLove, Doinb, and knight. === Individual Awards === * Worlds Finals MVP (2019) * LPL MVP x2(Summer 2022, Summer 2024) * LPL 1st All Pro Team x4 (Spring 2019, Summer 2019, Summer 2022, Summer 2024) * LPL 2nd All Pro Team (Spring 2020) * LPL 3rd All Pro Team (Summer 2021) {{PlayerStatsTrivia}} == Tournament Results == {{PlayerResults|show=overviewpage}}
